Regression fixture: qwen2_5 assistant TextBlock starts with '
'. Locks the conditional Option C fix that, when body_text starts with '
', moves the trailing '
' from the MARKER segment into the head of the CONTENT segment. Without the fix, two-piece tokenization produces 1 phantom token vs jinja (BPE drift across the assistant
 + 
Body seam). Unlike qwen3 (which lstrips), qwen2_5 jinja preserves the leading '
', so the fix MUST keep the wire string identical — conditional Option C achieves that by relocating the '
' across the segment boundary instead of dropping it. expected.oracle_ok=false documents a DELIBERATE L2 (loss-mask) divergence from the jinja-then-mask baseline at the merged '

' BPE token (token id 271, idx 33): native gives this token loss=msg_weight (it lives inside CONTENT under Option C); jinja-then-mask baseline assigns it IGNORE_INDEX (everything before response body start is masked). This trade-off is required by the BPE-stability fix and is consistent with HF Trainer's actual behaviour when apply_chat_template output is tokenized once and masked by response-prefix offset.
